critique_history.assessment:
- Pale dorsal plates read as foreign scales, not subtle shell mottling; remove them and use shader-based mottling.
- Walking legs bunch into rear-facing bundles; spread four articulated legs laterally on each side.
- Pincer fingers are short and blunt, weakening the open-claw silhouette; lengthen, taper, and separate them.
- Make the dominant claw more obviously larger and more elongated than the opposing claw.
The crab is complete and recognizable, with a broad glossy shell, eight attached legs, visible eye stalks, and prominent unequal red-and-white claws.
